blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The number of buses operating along the Edsa Carousel is expected to reach 450 by the end of the year as the government prepares for increased passenger demand during the holiday season, a transportation official said. Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said the Department of Transportation (DOTr) would deploy another 50 buses to the busway in December, on top of the 50 additional units already deployed ahead of the 49th Asean Summit.
